pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions until the primary trade achieves a minimum unhedged floating profit of +$6.00 and stop-loss is moved to breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require confirmation of liquidity sweep and volume delta divergence on the 1-minute chart prior to order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume at +$10.00 and trail the remaining position with an aggressive parabolic stop-loss to capture +$25.00+ runs.
